summary.goal: Define the core domain types for multi-plan builds: Build entity, BuildRun join entity, BuildTier grouping, BuildRequest input schema, and BuildStatus lifecycle.

acceptance_criteria.description: Build entity has: build_id, status, tiers, concurrency_limit, skip_completed flag, mode, workspace_path, timestamps
BuildRun entity links a run to a build with: build_id, run_id, plan_id, tier number, status
BuildStatus enum: pending, running, completed, failed, paused, cancelled
BuildRequest Zod schema validates the API input (tiers of plan_ids + options)
createBuild() factory function produces a Build from a BuildRequest
All types exported from forge-core domain index

types.Build: build_id, status, tiers (stored as JSON), concurrency_limit, skip_completed, mode, workspace_path, error, created_at, started_at, completed_at, updated_at
types.BuildRun: build_id, run_id, plan_id, plan_version, tier, status, created_at, updated_at
types.BuildRequest: { tiers: BuildTier[], mode?, workspace_path?, concurrency_limit?, skip_completed? }
types.BuildStatus: pending | running | completed | failed | paused | cancelled

architect.notes: Build.tiers is stored as JSONB in the builds table — the tier structure is write-once. BuildRun tracks the actual execution state per plan.

steps.title: Define BuildStatus enum and BuildRunStatus enum
steps.description: Add BuildStatus and BuildRunStatus as const objects with string values + extracted TypeScript types + Zod schemas, following the existing RunStatus/TaskStatus pattern in domain/types.ts.

acceptance_criteria.description: BuildStatus const: { Pending: 'pending', Running: 'running', Completed: 'completed', Failed: 'failed', Paused: 'paused', Cancelled: 'cancelled' }
BuildRunStatus const: { Pending: 'pending', Running: 'running', Completed: 'completed', Failed: 'failed', Skipped: 'skipped' }
BuildStatusSchema and BuildRunStatusSchema as z.enum()
VALID_BUILD_TRANSITIONS record mapping each status to valid next statuses
validateBuildTransition() throws on invalid transitions

architecture.pattern: Separate file from types.ts to keep build concerns isolated. Same const-enum + Zod pattern as RunStatus.

steps.title: Define BuildTier and BuildRequest Zod schemas
steps.description: Define the input schemas for creating a build. BuildTier is { tier: number, plan_ids: string[] }. BuildRequest includes tiers array + optional config fields.

acceptance_criteria.description: BuildTierSchema: z.object({ tier: z.number().int().nonnegative(), plan_ids: z.array(z.string().uuid()).min(1) })

BuildRequestSchema: z.object({ tiers: z.array(BuildTierSchema).min(1), mode: ForgeExecutionModeSchema.optional(), workspace_path: z.string().optional(), concurrency_limit: z.number().int().positive().default(5), skip_completed: z.boolean().default(false) })
Refine: tiers must have unique tier numbers and be sequential starting from 0
Refine: no duplicate plan_ids across all tiers

architecture.validation: Use .refine() for cross-tier uniqueness checks. Tier numbers must be 0..N-1 with no gaps.

steps.title: Define Build and BuildRun entity schemas
steps.description: Define the full entity Zod schemas for Build and BuildRun, matching what gets stored and returned from storage.

acceptance_criteria.description: BuildSchema: z.object({ build_id: z.string().uuid(), status: BuildStatusSchema, tiers: z.array(BuildTierSchema), concurrency_limit: z.number(), skip_completed: z.boolean(), mode: z.string(), workspace_path: z.string().nullable(), error: z.string().nullable(), created_at: z.string(), started_at: z.string().nullable(), completed_at: z.string().nullable(), updated_at: z.string() })

BuildRunSchema: z.object({ build_id: z.string().uuid(), run_id: z.string().uuid(), plan_id: z.string().uuid(), plan_version: z.number().int().nullable(), tier: z.number().int(), status: BuildRunStatusSchema, created_at: z.string(), updated_at: z.string() })
Type aliases: type Build = z.infer<typeof BuildSchema>, type BuildRun = z.infer<typeof BuildRunSchema>

architecture.pattern: Same Zod-first approach as Run/Task. Types inferred from schemas.

steps.title: Implement createBuild() and createBuildRun() factory functions
steps.description: Factory functions that produce validated Build and BuildRun entities from input data. createBuild takes a BuildRequest and returns a Build with generated UUID and pending status. createBuildRun takes build_id, plan_id, tier and returns a BuildRun.

acceptance_criteria.description: createBuild(request: BuildRequest): Build — generates UUID, sets status='pending', timestamps, validates via BuildSchema.parse()
createBuildRun(opts: { build_id, run_id, plan_id, plan_version?, tier }): BuildRun — sets status='pending', timestamps, validates via BuildRunSchema.parse()
Both functions throw ZodError on invalid input

architecture.pattern: Same as createRun() and createTask() — generate IDs, set defaults, validate with schema.parse()

steps.title: Export build types from domain index
steps.description: Re-export all build domain types, schemas, enums, factory functions, and transition validators from domain/index.ts and the top-level forge-core index.

acceptance_criteria.description: domain/index.ts re-exports: BuildStatus, BuildStatusSchema, BuildRunStatus, BuildRunStatusSchema, BuildSchema, Build, BuildRunSchema, BuildRun, BuildTierSchema, BuildTier, BuildRequestSchema, BuildRequest, createBuild, createBuildRun, VALID_BUILD_TRANSITIONS, validateBuildTransition
All types importable via '@plannr/forge-core'
